functions.notes: Registers differ throughout (target: archive r4, filename r6, length r7, pair ptr r8; ours: r7, r5, r8, r6). Target failure path holds NULL in r4 across Reset/Destroy (mov r4,#0 then mov r0,r4), ours emits mov r0,#0 after calls, so 4 bytes short; result-variable forms were folded away. pair.machine used directly (sp+0x1c) matched address; colorsweep gave no improvement.
